messages:
jess_finance: Heads up — reconciliation flagged ~24 invoices with missing totals after last night's webhook batch. NetSuite invoice numbers don't line up with Stripe events on several. Anyone on the connector?

mike_eng: saw alerts earlier. deploy-bot logged a big spike in webhook retries around 03:12 UTC. looks like our relay hit stripe rate limits and we retried whole batches, which may have caused ordering issues.

rahul_sre: confirmed in infra logs: multiple 429 responses from Stripe API for /v1/events. retries used existing batch payloads (no per-event idempotency), so some events were delivered twice and out of original order.

anna_fin: immediate impact: a subset of invoices were created twice then auto-merged by NS nightly job, which zeroed one line item during the merge. customers impacted: 6 accounts, est $3,400 of misapplied revenue. need to know if finance should issue credits/manual adjustments.

mike_eng: probable root cause: our webhook relay groups events into 20-event batches to upstream processor. when a batch fails we requeue the entire batch. on retry the connector applied events that had already been handled, because we never checked stripe event.id dedupe. also netsuite connector expects monotonic sequence numbers so out-of-order deliveries triggered merge logic.

rahul_sre: temp mitigation applied: switched DLQ replays to single-event mode and isolated remaining failing batches to a quarantine queue. rolled a staging hotfix that enforces event.id dedupe in the relay (feature flag). monitoring enabled for duplicate event hits.

jess_finance: good. we need a CSV of affected invoices + customers. can we also get approval to issue manual credits up to $3.5k to avoid collection noise? tagging @carl_ops for ops approval.

carl_ops: approved. proceed with manual credits/adjustments. please include comment lines referencing the replay, add audit tags, and cc finance-ops for the ticket. :white_check_mark:

mike_eng: longer-term fix plan: 1) deploy dedupe check to prod (event.id based) 2) change retry behavior to per-event backoff, not whole-batch 3) patch netsuite connector to prefer Stripe event.id for idempotency instead of internal sequence when available 4) run a safe backfill to reapply missing amounts and re-run nightly reconciliation. ETA ~6 hours for prod deploy + backfill window.

jess_finance: timeline works. please dump reconciliation CSV to /shared/finance/webhook-incident/2265432100.csv and assign a ticket for the manual credit work with links to the CSV. notify when DLQ fully drained and nightly reconciliation completes. :eyes:

mike_eng: will do. sample payload we used to validate dedupe logic:

```json
{
  "id": "evt_3KxyzA1b2c3D4e",
  "type": "invoice.payment_succeeded",
  "data": {
    "object": {
      "id": "in_1JlmNo2Pq3R4S",
      "amount_paid": 1200,
      "lines": [ /* ... */ ]
    }
  },
  "created": 1670000000
}
```

mike_eng: note — for the backfill we'll only reapply events that pass the event.id dedupe check in a dry run first, then move to actual apply once finance validates the CSV.

rahul_sre: adding alert for any future batch replays that exceed 5% duplicate rate. rolling this into postmortem doc.

jess_finance: thanks team — keep updates short here and send the CSV once ready.
